narrative_purpose: A decorative atmospheric layer for the chapter - faint drifting silhouettes of winged fliers dissolving into the dark sky, setting mood behind the text without competing with it.
subject: An abstract field of faint, repeating ghost-silhouettes of wide-winged fliers - banshees and a great leonopteryx - scattered and overlapping at low opacity like distant shapes wheeling in a vast hazy sky, fading toward the edges into pure void. A few barely-there floating peaks drift among them.
scene: Bottomless dark sky, the winged silhouettes suspended and receding, no ground, no horizon, only deep atmospheric haze.
camera: A drifting, depthless high-altitude field view with no single focus, fliers at varied scales and softness.
light: Very low bioluminescent glow tracing a few of the wing-frames, most barely visible; deep indigo throughout.
palette: Almost entirely void-indigo and deep teal-indigo, the faintest cyan tracing, no warm accents.
style: Painterly atmospheric wash, hand-painted haze, deliberately low-contrast and unobtrusive.
detail_level: Intentionally soft everywhere - a mood layer, no sharp focal point, fliers dissolving into dark.
composition: An even, edge-darkened field with no dominant subject, safe for text overlay, generous void.
consistency_notes: Cool Pandora palette, extremely restrained. A background plate only - must never compete with foreground text or figures.
negative_prompt: no text, no lettering, no numbers, no logos, no labels, no arrows, no high-contrast focal subject, no photographic or 3D-render look, no cartoon or anime style
